browseToEdit: A semantic result button opens a single Cell editor and replaces the browse surface.
back: Returns to the same scope, query/filter, captured map snapshot, and scroll position; restores focus to the originating result when it remains available.
inspectorHandoff: Contextual Inspector Edit in Inventory sets the exact Cell ID and opens EDIT ONE directly.

existingActions.reset: Removes the Cell rfProfile override and retains identity/location.
existingActions.duplicate: Uses the existing deep-copy, unique suffix, coordinate offset, and add/select/invalidate behavior.
existingActions.delete: Uses existing delete and Undo behavior, including Network membership/azimuth restoration.
existingActions.position: Uses existing coordinate validation and RF-result invalidation.

focus: Cell heading receives focus on entry; Back restores the originating result button.
evidence: Inventory browsing opens a separate editor without changing RF or Map Focus
Inventory editor returns keyboard focus to the exact browse row
